questions.question: What does rust around wheel nuts mean?
questions.explanation: Check your tires before every drive. Rust around wheel nuts shows they may be loose.

questions.question: When making tight turns, what should a driver do?

options.text: Open their door for a better look.

questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors regularly while driving. Check them especially when changing lanes, turning, merging, or making tight turns.

questions.question: If you double your speed from 20 to 40 mph, your braking distance will become how many times longer?
questions.explanation: When you double your speed, your braking distance becomes four times longer. A collision at double speed will also have four times more impact.

questions.question: The driver is responsible for safely transporting cargo.
questions.explanation: The driver is responsible for safely transporting cargo, no matter who loaded the vehicle.

questions.question: When going down a steep hill, when should you shift to a lower gear?

options.text: After you have already started the hill
As far down the hill as possible
At the bottom of the hill

questions.explanation: Shift to a lower gear before starting down a hill. This helps you control your speed without using your brakes too much.

questions.question: Black ice is usually very thick.
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice. You can see the road through it, so it looks like the road is just wet.

questions.question: Which statement about distracted driving is correct?

options.text: It only comes from physical distractions, not mental ones.
You can avoid it by eating while driving.
You can avoid it by not having complex conversations while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can avoid it by not having complex conversations while driving.
questions.explanation: Do not have complex or emotionally intense conversations while driving. Pre-program your radio before you drive and avoid eating, drinking, or smoking at the wheel. Mental distractions can be as dangerous as physical distractions.

questions.question: When making a tight turn, what should you do with your mirrors?

options.text: Do not use them—they are too distracting.
Use them, but not very often.

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often when making tight turns.

questions.question: If you double your speed from 20 to 40 mph, what happens to your braking distance?
questions.explanation: Higher speed increases both your braking distance and impact force. Doubling your speed from 20 to 40 mph multiplies your braking distance by four.

questions.question: Which item can never be transported in the passenger compartment of a bus?
questions.explanation: Buses can never carry labeled radioactive materials where passengers sit. Small arms ammunition labeled ORM-D and emergency hospital supplies are allowed.

questions.question: What is the minimum tread depth required for rear tires?
questions.explanation: Front tires need at least 4/32 of an inch of tread depth. Rear tires need at least 2/32 of an inch of tread depth. All tires on the same vehicle should be the same size.

questions.question: When using a fire extinguisher, what should you do?

options.text: Get as close to the fire as possible
Stand as far away from the fire as possible
Aim at the top of the fire

questions.correctAnswerText: Stand as far away from the fire as possible
questions.explanation: Stand as far away from the fire as possible. Aim at the base of the fire, not at the flames. If you are unsure which type of extinguisher to use, wait for firefighters to arrive.

questions.question: What affects stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on the vehicle's speed, weight, and how much traction the road surface provides.

questions.question: In extremely hot weather, if your tire air pressure is too high, what should you do?

options.text: Let air out of the tire
Stop and let the tires cool before driving

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the tires cool before driving
questions.explanation: Heat causes air to expand, which can make tire pressure dangerously high. Stop and let your tires cool. Do not let air out, because the pressure will drop too low once the tires cool.

questions.question: What happens as a vehicle gets heavier?

options.text: The brakes have to work harder

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes have to work harder
questions.explanation: Heavier vehicles require their brakes to work harder to stop completely.

questions.question: After picking up passengers, what should a driver do?

options.text: Let passengers sit or get settled before starting to drive
Honk the horn and enter traffic right away

questions.correctAnswerText: Let passengers sit or get settled before starting to drive
questions.explanation: Start and stop smoothly to keep passengers safe. Give passengers time to sit down or hold on before you begin driving.

questions.question: What is true about hydroplaning?

options.text: It rarely happens with large trucks
It usually happens only above 65 mph
It can happen with just a small amount of water on the road

questions.correctAnswerText: It can happen with just a small amount of water on the road
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when tires lose grip on the road and slide on a layer of water. You do not need a large amount of water for this to occur.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT required to mark hazardous materials?

options.text: The phone number of a contact person

questions.correctAnswerText: The phone number of a contact person
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials must have the material name, identification number, and hazard label. A contact phone number is not required. Only transport hazardous materials if you are certain it is allowed.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, how should you start?

options.text: Turn the steering wheel in the direction of the turn
Turn the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the turn
Turn the wheel as sharply as possible

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the turn
questions.explanation: Begin backing by turning the steering wheel opposite to the direction you want to go. Once the trailer turns, reverse your steering direction to follow it.

questions.question: Which surface is the most slippery?
questions.explanation: Wet ice forms when it is warm enough to melt ice slightly. Wet ice is much more slippery than dry ice.
